# Babawatoto Organization (BAO)

> Babawatoto Centre for Children and Youth Trust (BAO) is a registered non-governmental organization in Tanzania dedicated to protecting vulnerable street-connected children, restoring families, and empowering youth through education, creative arts therapy, and vocational livelihoods.

## Core Initiatives
- [Child Protection & Street Outreach](https://babawatoto.or.tz/programmes/child-protection): Daytime street outreach, crisis identification, family tracing, and reunification.
- [MEMKWA Catch-Up Education](https://babawatoto.or.tz/programmes/memkwa-education): Accelerated primary and secondary catch-up learning for out-of-school adolescents.
- [HEART & Creative Arts](https://babawatoto.or.tz/programmes/heart-arts): Healing and Education Through the Arts (acrobatics, theatre, music, and psychosocial resilience).
- [Vocational Training & Livelihoods](https://babawatoto.or.tz/programmes/vocational-skills): Skills acquisition, apprenticeships, and youth enterprise development.

## Organization Details
- **Registration**: Registered Trust in the United Republic of Tanzania
- **Headquarters**: Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
- **Website**: https://babawatoto.or.tz
- **CMS**: https://cms.babawatoto.or.tz
- **Contact**: info@babawatoto.or.tz
